jd_snapshot: Requisition 43037. 'The Business/Systems Analyst will study the business and information needs of specific customer groups and of the Laboratory as a whole to develop information systems solutions.' Primary duties: financial systems (SAP FI/CO) operational support and continuous improvement, requirements/functional-spec documentation, project management, systems upgrade/implementation with regression testing, communication/training/documentation, business planning. Minimum qualifications: 'Bachelor's degree plus a minimum of seven years of experience OR a master's degree and minimum two years of experience OR equivalent'; '7+ years of SAP FI/CO experience in requirements gathering, deployment and support'; '7+ years of experience with SAP ERP business processes design, implementation and support'; plus analytical/communication/project-management skills. Preferred: other SAP ERP modules, SAP BW/Business Objects, SAP Concur, change-management tools, large-IT-project PM experience. Remote condition (verbatim): 'THE SELECTED CANDIDATE CAN BE REMOTE BUT NEEDS TO BE WITHIN 100 MILES OF THE LAB IN LEXINGTON, MA.' Apply control observed: button 'Apply now >>' linking to a relative path. Full verbatim consolidated text, capture methodology, and a note on a minor structural-placement ambiguity for the citizenship/clearance sentence are recorded in jd.txt and capture_notes.md in this same fixture directory.
work_authorization_wording: US citizenship required to obtain and maintain a security clearance. Selected candidate will be subject to a pre-employment background investigation and must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret level DoD security clearance.
